apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar-hack
apps.versionDescription: v9.0c — cosmic. Skelli gains a world-sense and a will: an almanac (where she is, the weather anywhere, the calendar, a book of hours she keeps herself), feelings proven rather than announced, apologies she judges on their merits, a voice that composes its own sentences, and a halo that reads her. Conversation no longer falls off her — fragments complete themselves, conversions and date sums are exact, and her memory answers from the sealed journal. Annoyed is not mad. Carries gamma entire — the crash-proofing program and the no-crash standard — with haptics made whole throughout.
